summary: CWE-674: helperBad recursed starting from Long.MAX_VALUE with only a `level == 0` base case, so the terminating condition is never reached in any practical sense and the stack overflows. Added an upper-bound guard mirroring the safe helper (helperGood1) so excessively deep recursion is rejected before it exhausts the stack, while legitimate in-range levels still recurse and terminate normally.
